recipes.title: Zero-reciprocal-energy endmember estimate
recipes.description: Close a reciprocal square by explicitly assuming its reciprocal energy is zero.
recipes.applicability: A missing hypothetical endmember and three compatible reference energies.
limitations: Zero reciprocal energy is an assumption, not symmetry or a general identity; original cited method still needs tracing.
validation_tests: With consistent labels check G(A:C)+G(B:D)-G(A:D)-G(B:C)=0 and validate withheld energies.

recipes.title: Explicit SRO contribution review
recipes.description: Consider a documented SRO approximation and separate it from existing energetic contributions.
recipes.applicability: Short-range order affects thermodynamic observables beyond the chosen baseline.
limitations: A generic reciprocal interaction is not proof of a validated SRO treatment.
validation_tests: Compare random and ordered limits and independently measured thermochemistry.
